WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree (id) AS ( SELECT id FROM rbac_department WHERE id = #{departmentId} UNION ALL SELECT d.id FROM rbac_department d INNER JOIN dept_tree t ON d.parent_id = t.id ) SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.user_type AS userType, u.status AS status FROM rbac_user_department ud INNER JOIN dept_tree t ON t.id = ud.department_id INNER JOIN rbac_user u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id ASC
